project_type: Single-page HTML application with embedded JavaScript calculator for insurance premium rates
build_system: None - static HTML file, no build process required
test_framework: None - manual verification via Python scripts against known reference values from PDF filenames
test_command: python3 verify_calculator.py (to be created as verification script)
verification_instructions: 1. Parse the generated HTML to extract the embedded JSON data. 2. Cross-reference premium values against known PDF reference cases: (a) Pria 40th Flexi A 1M Premi ~4jt MPP YRT, (b) Pria 40th Flexi B 1M Premi ~22jt MPP 15th, (c) Pria 40th Flexi C 1M Term 15th Premi ~140jt MPP 5th. 3. Verify all calculation modes produce correct output. 4. Verify frequency multipliers are applied correctly.
setup_instructions: No setup needed. Python 3.11 available for CSV parsing scripts.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode. No external packages can be installed. Only Python standard library available (no openpyxl, pandas, etc.). CSV must be parsed with custom logic due to thousand-separator commas in numeric fields.
contribution_requirements: Single HTML file must remain self-contained. All rate data must be embedded as JavaScript object within the HTML.
key_patterns: Current HTML is 781 lines with CSS+HTML+JS in one file. Calculator uses tabs (tab6). Existing JS has a mock getBaseRate() function that only handles a few hardcoded age/gender combos and returns dummy '10000000' for all other cases.
directory_structure: Flat repo with HTML files, CSV data, PDFs, and XLS files. Main calculator file is MPS_Flexi_Updated.html.

data_structure_notes.csv_parsing: CSV has thousand-separator commas in numeric fields (e.g., '1,034.9' splits into multiple CSV fields). Must use custom parser that merges fields when a field is pure digits (no decimal) followed by a 3-digit field.
data_structure_notes.zero_means_unavailable: Cells with '-' in CSV represent unavailable combinations

plan_structure.Flexi Amanah: Term=YRT/5/10, PPP(MasaBayar)=1/5/10. Masa Perlindungan = Term. Ages with data: 18-70 (ages 0-17 all dashes). Some lower UP columns are '-' for younger ages (below min premi).
plan_structure.Flexi Berkah: Masa Perlindungan always = 110 (until age 110). PPP=5/10/15. Term column shows (110-age) for PPP=5, empty for PPP=10/15. All ages 0-70 have rates.
plan_structure.Flexi Cermat: Term=15/25/35 (Masa Perlindungan). PPP=5/10/15. Rows with empty Term inherit from the preceding non-empty Term row. All ages 0-70 have rates. NOTE: Term=15 only has PPP=5 and PPP=10 (no PPP=15).

data_structure_notes.non_linearity: Berkah has volume discounts at higher UP levels (rate per 100Jt decreases). Amanah and Cermat are roughly linear.
